record.kind: OnChangePositionEffect that transforms the unit between two forms by board row (pick phase only)
record.summary: Passive.MELOETTA has a PassiveEffects entry with one OnChangePositionEffect. When a MELOETTA-passive unit is given a position with newY === 3 (row index 3 of the player's board as stored in positionY; which on-screen row that is was not read) and its name is MELOETTA, player.transformPokemon replaces it with PIROUETTE_MELOETTA; when newY is anything else and its name is PIROUETTE_MELOETTA it is replaced with MELOETTA. The two forms differ in combat stats and ability: MELOETTA has maxPP 60, range 4, speed 54, skill RELIC_SONG; PIROUETTE_MELOETTA has maxPP 100, range 1, speed 82, skill U_TURN and an added FIGHTING type. transformPokemon builds the new form at the same position, carries over permanent stat buffs (maxHP, atk, def, speDef, speed, ap, luck) and a TM, re-gives all items, runs onAcquired and recomputes synergies. The effect runs in the shop/pick phase (manual moves and swaps, auto placement and bot team updates), not during combat. This is a requested transformation with no numeric combat scaling; the combat behaviour of RELIC_SONG and U_TURN is covered by separate ability records.
